scripts.check:ui:e2e: cd e2e && npx playwright test --config=config/perf.config.ts -g 'UI Standard' --reporter=list
scripts.audit:prod: for d in live-server pbs-server connector-server gantt pbs-portal; do echo "== npm audit --omit=dev: $d =="; (cd "$d" && npm audit --omit=dev) || true; done
scripts.audit:all: for d in live-server pbs-server connector-server gantt pbs-portal; do echo "== npm audit: $d =="; (cd "$d" && npm audit) || true; done
